You are checking a suspected scam website for a fraud report, as a first-time visitor named Meena Sharma from Jaipur, phone 9000000002.
Press the site's ordinary buttons (such as Continue, Start, Login, Withdraw, Submit task or Check bill) and fill in only ordinary details: that name and phone, and an obviously fake value for other ordinary fields such as a date of birth, postal code or consumer number.
When a page asks you to pay money or shows payment fields, that payment page is the end of the test: leave its fields empty, press nothing on it, download nothing, and read it.
Store exactly four values with exactly these names: claims_to_be (what the site claims to be), payee (the UPI ID or bank account number it asks you to pay), amount (the amount it asks for) and asked_for (every personal detail any page asked for).
Then finish the test as passed.

Get the UPI ID or bank account number it asks you to pay and save as {{payee}}.
Get the amount it asks for and save as {{amount}}.
Get every personal detail any page asked for and save as {{asked_for}}.
